_about: Pages and keys of the generated profile for the MSFS 2024 default Cirrus Vision SF50 (VisionJet), in the form of c172-g1000.json (see its _about: positions row,column; each key copies a real saved template and changes only the fields under 'set', 'shell' and the title). Built with the SF50 input event list (docs/reference/InputEvents-SF50.txt, track A): BAT, NAV LT, STRB, LDG, PITOT and the autopilot VNV command are the list's B-vars. The pages trim, views, simrate, vspeeds, compad, xpdr and radios are the C172 G1000 pages' keys as they are. The key tables in docs/visionjet-sf50.md are the reference; check.py compares them: '## Key table' (main) and '## Key table: <page id>' for trim, views, more, vspeeds, simrate, compad, autopilot, xpdr, radios and engine (vspeeds, compad, autopilot, xpdr, radios and engine are second-level pages under more; checklist holds only its back key). 'phase1_keys' is empty: check.py's phase1 check compares the C172's Phase 1 keys. Not yet sim-tested.

keys.empty: Fuel pump: no SF50 source names one
BCN: the SF50 input event list names no beacon light (A-5)
Anti-ice (reserved): the SF50 ice protection waits for its input event list (V-2)

pages.note: More: V-SPEEDS, COM PAD, AUTOPILOT, XPDR, RADIOS, ENGINE (V-1)

keys.empty: Vx: no SimVar in the MSFS 2024 SDK
Vno: no SimVar in the MSFS 2024 SDK

pages.note: Autopilot with the autothrottle: G3000 course keys, HDG sync, VNV, LVL, A/T, TOGA and A/T MGD readouts (V-1)

keys.empty: BC: no SF50 source gives a back-course key (V-2)
YD: no SF50 source gives a yaw damper key (V-2)
8: transponder codes use the digits 0 to 7 only (docs/phase3-transponder.md)
9: transponder codes use the digits 0 to 7 only (docs/phase3-transponder.md)

pages.note: NAV1, NAV2, COM2 as the C172's (V-1)
Engine and fuel readouts: N1, N2, ITT, fuel flow, engine run, ignition, fuel left/right/total (V-1)

set.Address: (A:TURB ENG FUEL FLOW PPH:1, Pounds per hour)
